mcg.name: the Melbourne Cricket Ground (MCG), Melbourne, on a sunny Boxing Day Test
mcg.far: the MCG Members Reserve: a huge tall stand with tiers of packed seats, the grand old Long Room glass front at its base and a white cantilever roof, tall white floodlight towers with their big angled light banks either side, and the Melbourne city skyline behind under a blue summer sky
mcg.left: the giant Great Southern Stand, a sweeping three-tier bowl of packed seats with a white roof edge, a floodlight tower rising behind it
mcg.right: the Olympic Stand, tiers of packed seats with a white roof edge and a big video screen frame on top
mcg.near: the Ponsford Stand, a tall multi-tier stand with glass boxes and a white roof edge, packed with fans
mcg.crowd: chunky cartoon Aussie fans in green-and-gold shirts, floppy sunhats and zinc-cream noses, some in Santa hats
mcg.light: bright Australian summer sun from top-left with soft glow

scg.name: the Sydney Cricket Ground (SCG), Sydney, on a sunny New Year Test
scg.far: the heritage Members Pavilion and Ladies Stand: elegant old buildings with green copper roofs, white iron lace balconies and a little clock turret, packed with members in pink, flanked by modern white stands, with the Sydney skyline and a fig tree behind under a blue sky
scg.left: the big modern Victor Trumper Stand, tiers of packed seats with a white sail-like roof
scg.right: the grassy Doug Walters Hill of fans on picnic rugs merging into the modern Clive Churchill Stand with a white roof
scg.near: the modern Noble Bradman Messenger Stand, tiers of packed seats with glass boxes and a white roof edge
scg.crowd: chunky cartoon fans in pink for the Pink Test, plus green-and-gold shirts and sunhats
scg.light: bright Sydney summer sun from top-right with soft glow

gabba.name: the Gabba, Brisbane, on a hot sunny day
gabba.far: the Gabba's big round bowl end: tall tiers of packed maroon seats under a white roof, with a giant video screen frame on top and tall floodlight towers either side, palm trees and the Brisbane skyline behind under a hot blue sky
gabba.left: a sweeping bowl stand of packed maroon seats with a white roof edge
gabba.right: a sweeping bowl stand of packed maroon seats with a white roof edge and a big Lions-style banner
gabba.near: the bowl's near tier, a tall stand of packed maroon seats with glass boxes and a white roof edge
gabba.crowd: chunky cartoon Queensland fans in maroon shirts and broad-brimmed hats, waving inflatable crocodiles
gabba.light: hot bright Queensland sun from top-left with soft glow

optus.name: Optus Stadium, Perth, on a sunny evening
optus.far: Optus Stadium's huge modern bowl end: tiers of packed seats under the famous white rippling roof canopy that glows with a band of bronze-gold lights along its edge, and the Swan River with the Perth skyline beyond under a golden evening sky
optus.left: a sweeping modern bowl stand of packed seats under the white roof canopy with its gold light band
optus.right: a sweeping modern bowl stand of packed seats under the white roof canopy with its gold light band
optus.near: the bowl's near tier, tall packed stands under the white roof canopy edge with its gold light band
optus.crowd: chunky cartoon Western Australia fans in gold and black, some in big sunhats
optus.light: warm golden evening sun from top-right with soft glow

adelaide.name: the Adelaide Oval, Adelaide, on a sunny afternoon
adelaide.far: the famous green-roofed heritage scoreboard building with its white clock and wooden numbers, sitting behind the top tip of the field between grassy hills and big Moreton Bay fig trees, with the twin spires of St Peter's Cathedral rising behind under a blue sky
adelaide.left: the modern Western Stand with its sweeping white sail roof and tiers of packed seats
adelaide.right: the modern Riverbank Stand with its sweeping white sail roof and tiers of packed seats
adelaide.near: the modern Eastern Stand with its sweeping white sail roof, glass boxes and tiers of packed seats
adelaide.crowd: chunky cartoon South Australia fans in red, blue and gold, some in sunhats
adelaide.light: warm afternoon sun from top-left with soft glow
